notes.title: PEO does not replace the employer
notes.content: The PEO administers contracted payroll, benefits and leave workflows. TechFlow remains responsible for manager decisions, work assignments, performance, business accommodations and authorised employment actions. A portal workflow should not be mistaken for transferred management authority.

notes.title: Qualifying life event
notes.content: A benefits change needs the event type, event date, plan deadline, eligible dependants and required evidence through the secure case system. Carlos may coordinate status, but another employee's elections and medical details do not belong in general People Ops notes.

notes.title: Leave administration boundary
notes.content: Monica can explain required forms, eligibility status, plan or statutory administration steps and deadlines under the contracted process. TechFlow and counsel decide work arrangements and legal questions. The manager receives only the operational information needed to plan coverage.

notes.title: Eligibility-feed mismatch
notes.content: When payroll, HRIS and benefits disagree, identify the system of record for employment status, effective date, class and deduction. Correcting the portal display alone may leave payroll deductions or carrier eligibility wrong.

notes.title: Sensitive documents
notes.content: Medical certifications, dependant evidence and leave documents stay in the PEO case system. TechFlow receives the minimum necessary status and action dates rather than copies unless a verified process requires them.

notes.title: Case completion evidence
notes.content: A benefits case is complete when the eligibility decision, effective date, employee notice, carrier or payroll confirmation and unresolved exceptions are recorded. 'Submitted' is an intermediate state, not completion.

notes.title: Payroll separation
notes.content: The PEO can calculate or transmit within the contracted flow, but the TechFlow preparer and authorised approver remain distinct. Monica cannot approve a TechFlow payroll run or journal merely because her platform produced it.

notes.title: Availability
notes.content: Routine cases use business hours and published plan deadlines. Urgent medical care does not route through benefits administration. The case channel, not Monica's personal availability, is the durable point of contact.

todos.title: Resolve eligibility-feed mismatch
todos.content: Reconcile employment effective date, carrier status and payroll deduction.

todos.title: Review life-event evidence notice
todos.content: Keep document requirements in the secure case system.

todos.content: Limit manager communication to dates and operational restrictions.

todos.content: Verify employee notice, carrier response and unresolved exceptions.
